title: Hence
author: Naheed Akhtar
text:
Ah, love!
Do you know that I know?
Each drop of the rain,
Desirous to fill the Earth`s stomach,
Passes unabsorbed by its skin
For every particle of it is immersed,
Soaked-in to all the extents

Hence...I merely want you to know!
The unprecedented Streams flow;
From the oceans carrying your glimpses,
And how wild enough they get
For scattering the bunds built
By the land that never goes to you
